**Issue #4926 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4926: Patch: honor E2E_ARTIFACTS in the downloads folder and the replay-task log dir
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Two runs of the e2e suite on one machine would stop sharing evidence files. Today setting `E2E_ARTIFACTS` moves screenshots and videos aside, but the downloads folder and the replay-task log files still land in the shared `artifacts/` directory, so parallel runs overwrite each other's evidence. After this change everything the run writes honors the variable, and an unset variable behaves byte-for-byte as today.

## Why

`e2e/README.md` blesses parallel runs (`E2E_ARTIFACTS=artifacts/my-run E2E_KEEP_ASSETS=1 ...`, noting Cypress empties its screenshots folder at the start of every run). `e2e/cypress.config.ts` honors the variable for `screenshotsFolder` and `videosFolder` in both the e2e and component blocks, but the e2e block's `downloadsFolder` is hardcoded to `artifacts/downloads`, and the component block's comment explains exactly why sharing is harmful (a run silently deleting the evidence a red run just left). Separately, `e2e/support/tasks/replay.ts` writes its evidence to `path.join(projectRoot, "artifacts")` with fixed labels (`01-hotseat-full-game`, ...), ignoring `E2E_ARTIFACTS`, so two simultaneous runs write the same `<label>.json` paths. The fix is three lines with no default-behavior change, so CI (which never sets the variable) is unaffected.

## Proposal

Base the e2e block's `downloadsFolder` on `${process.env.E2E_ARTIFACTS ?? "artifacts"}/downloads`, and base the replay task's log directory on `process.env.E2E_ARTIFACTS ?? "artifacts"` (read in the task process, which inherits the Cypress runner's environment). Add one line to `e2e/README.md`'s parallel-runs paragraph naming the two newly-moved outputs.

## Where it lands

- `e2e/cypress.config.ts` (e2e block `downloadsFolder`)
- `e2e/support/tasks/replay.ts` (log directory)
- `e2e/README.md` (parallel-runs paragraph)
- No SPEC section; this is harness behavior documented in `e2e/README.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With `E2E_ARTIFACTS` unset, the resolved Cypress config and the replay task write exactly the paths they do today (`artifacts/screenshots`, `artifacts/videos`, `artifacts/downloads`, `artifacts/<label>.json`).
- [ ] With `E2E_ARTIFACTS=artifacts/my-run`, downloads and replay logs land under `artifacts/my-run/` and two runs with different values leave each other's files alone.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` passes and the README paragraph describes all moved outputs.

## Size and risks

Small: two path expressions plus a doc line. Risk is a stale path in a debugging note somewhere; the change is greppable (`artifacts/downloads`, `"artifacts"` in `e2e/support/tasks`) and the default is untouched, so CI artifact handling cannot shift.

```ts
// Throwaway probe for #4926. Do not commit.
import { existsSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
const e2eDir = path.resolve("e2e");
function assert(cond: unknown, msg: string): void {
  if (!cond) { console.error(`FAIL: ${msg}`); process.exit(1); }
  console.log(`ok: ${msg}`);
}
const mode = process.argv[2];
if (mode === "config") {
  const mod = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(e2eDir, "cypress.config.ts")).href);
  const e2e = mod.default.e2e;
  const base = process.env.E2E_ARTIFACTS ?? "artifacts";
  assert(e2e.downloadsFolder === `${base}/downloads`, `downloadsFolder resolves under ${base}`);
  assert(e2e.screenshotsFolder === `${base}/screenshots`, "screenshotsFolder unchanged");
  assert(e2e.videosFolder === `${base}/videos`, "videosFolder unchanged");
} else if (mode === "replay") {
  const { replayHash } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(e2eDir, "support/tasks/replay.ts")).href);
  const payload = { label: "probe-tmp", seed: "1", decks: [[], []] as [string[], string[]], log: [], state: {} };
  process.env.E2E_ARTIFACTS = "artifacts/probe-run";
  try { replayHash(e2eDir, payload); } catch { /* the fold throws after the write; only the path matters */ }
  assert(existsSync(path.join(e2eDir, "artifacts/probe-run/probe-tmp.json")), "set: log lands under artifacts/probe-run/");
  assert(!existsSync(path.join(e2eDir, "artifacts/probe-tmp.json")), "set: shared artifacts/ untouched");
  rmSync(path.join(e2eDir, "artifacts/probe-run"), { recursive: true, force: true });
  delete process.env.E2E_ARTIFACTS;
  try { replayHash(e2eDir, payload); } catch { /* same */ }
  assert(existsSync(path.join(e2eDir, "artifacts/probe-tmp.json")), "unset: log lands at artifacts/probe-tmp.json");
  rmSync(path.join(e2eDir, "artifacts/probe-tmp.json"), { force: true });
} else { console.error("usage: probe-artifacts.ts config|replay"); process.exit(1); }
```

Run, in order: `pnpm exec tsx /tmp/probe-artifacts.ts config`; `E2E_ARTIFACTS=artifacts/my-run pnpm exec tsx /tmp/probe-artifacts.ts config`; `env -u E2E_ARTIFACTS pnpm exec tsx /tmp/probe-artifacts.ts replay`; `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` (covers both edited TS files via `e2e/tsconfig.json`'s include of `cypress.config.ts` and `support/**/*.ts`); then `git status --porcelain e2e/` must show only the three edited files. Grep that no literal remains: `artifacts/downloads` must appear only in `e2e/README.md`, and `"artifacts"` must no longer appear in `e2e/support/tasks/replay.ts`. If the `config` probe fails on module side effects (it imports `cypress`, the Vite plugin and `apps/web` configs), do not add dependencies: verify by typecheck plus diff review and report that the probe could not run.

## Done when

- [ ] Unset-variable probe asserts pass: config resolves to `artifacts/screenshots`, `artifacts/videos`, `artifacts/downloads`; replay writes `artifacts/probe-tmp.json`.
- [ ] Set-variable probes pass: `E2E_ARTIFACTS=artifacts/my-run` puts downloads under `artifacts/my-run/downloads` and the replay log under `artifacts/my-run/` with nothing in shared `artifacts/`.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` passes; README sentence names downloads and replay logs; worktree shows only the three intended files changed and probe leftovers removed.

## Risks

Absolute `E2E_ARTIFACTS` values would diverge between the config template (absolute wins) and `path.join` (appends); documented use is always relative (`artifacts/my-run`), so this stays out of scope — `path.resolve` was rejected because `path.join` keeps the default byte-identical. Two runs sharing one value still share files, by design. No committed regression test guards against a future re-hardcode; accepted for a three-line change, with the greps above as the guard. Do not run the Cypress suite or smoke specs to prove this; the probes plus typecheck are the check.

## Open questions

None.
````
